highlights: Deputy DSLs and section-specific safeguarding teams
Safe recruitment practices and safeguarding checks
Clear reporting procedures for students and parents
safety.policy_summary: Windfield International School maintains a comprehensive Child Protection and Safeguarding policy aimed at protecting children from abuse, neglect, exploitation, bullying, and discrimination. The school implements safe recruitment procedures, staff training, professional boundaries, and assigns a dedicated Safeguarding Team led by a Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL) and section-specific Deputy DSLs to support students and manage concerns.
